extractions.value: Initial presentation was with oculomotor and gait symptoms, followed by a relapsing-remitting course with full recovery after steroids, then relapse with brainstem features (bulbar palsy, gaze palsy, trismus, hemifacial and laryngeal spasms, respiratory arrest) and generalised myoclonus. Anti-glycine receptor antibodies were found on reanalysis of a sample sent for anti-NMDA-R. Breast cancer was diagnosed 18 months after onset. The patient died of malignancy-related complications.
